items.comment: Could you share a small, shareable CSV file (or paste its contents) that still triggers the error when run with `SELECT * FROM read_csv('input.csv');`, and include the complete, exact error message and the exact command you used? The reporter noted DuckDB CLI 1.5 on Ubuntu 24.04, so a minimal CSV that reproduces the `Conversion Error: CSV Error on Line: 4` will let maintainers reproduce the failure.
items.label: needs reproducible example
items.rationale: The report describes a CSV import failure but omits the input CSV or any sample data. Without the CSV contents (or a reproducible minimal sample) the failure cannot be reproduced. Environment/version is provided, so only the input data and full error text are essential.
